END IF;\n a:=(s->>'as_of')::timestamptz;e:=(s->>'expires_at')::timestamptz;IF e<=a OR e-a>interval '31 days' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n END IF;\n FOREACH k IN ARRAY ARRAY['highlights','posts'] '^https://www\\.instagram\\.com/(p|reel)/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$' AND u !~ '^https://www\\.facebook\\.com/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}/(posts|videos)/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}|reel/[0-9]{1,30})$' AND u !~
